units.text: I automated the 15 most used user flows as Playwright end-to-end tests and made any failing test block the release. Weekly releases have since run for 5 months without a rollback.
We moved the customer portal from our own servers to Google Cloud with a lift-and-shift approach and completed the switch in 3 months without downtime.
I added request validation with Pydantic and clear error codes to the partner API, and wrote the integration guide myself. Partner error reports fell from 25 to 6 per month.
